evidence_items.locator: Table 3, Object Counting row and caption
evidence_items.explanation: Object-counting accuracy was 44.0%, 45.2%, and 51.2% with answer-only prompts for InstructGPT, Codex, and PaLM; step-by-step prompts raised these to 77.2%, 93.2%, and 83.2%. The Codex result exceeded the average human-rater score of 86.1%, materially limiting any claim of general counting incapacity.

The study's Codex baseline scored 37.6% with direct answers and 73.0% with step-by-step answers. The 96.7% result used generated programs and a Python interpreter, showing an effective workaround while leaving direct counting errors substantial.
